diff --git a/taskcluster/docs/loading.rst b/taskcluster/docs/loading.rst
index e4066c524c0..b902b0dcf05 100644
--- a/taskcluster/docs/loading.rst
+++ b/taskcluster/docs/loading.rst
@@ -29,12 +29,12 @@ style pattern matching via `pathspec`.
 
 .. code-block:: yaml
   reference-tasks:
-    - linux64-aarch64-compiler-rt-18
+    - linux64-aarch64-compiler-rt-19
     - linux64-cargo-vet
     - linux64-cbindgen
     - linux64-cctools-port
-    - linux64-clang-18-profile
-    - linux64-clang-18-raw

 **or use wildcards**

-linux64-clang-18:
-    description: "Clang 18 toolchain build"
+linux64-clang-19:
+    description: "Clang 19 toolchain build"
     attributes:
         local-toolchain: true
     treeherder:
-        symbol: TL(clang-18)
+        symbol: TL(clang-19)
     worker-type: b-linux-gcp
     worker:
         max-run-time: 600

-            - win32-compiler-rt-18
-            - win64-aarch64-compiler-rt-18

     attributes:
         local-toolchain: true
     treeherder:
-        symbol: TW64(clang-18)
+        symbol: TW64(clang-19)
     worker-type: b-linux-gcp
     worker:
         max-run-time: 600
@@ -70,13 +70,13 @@ win64-clang-18:
     fetches:
         toolchain:
             - linux64-cctools-port
-            - win64-clang-18-raw
-            - linux64-aarch64-compiler-rt-18

-            - linux64-x86-compiler-rt-18
-            - macosx64-aarch64-compiler-rt-18
-            - macosx64-x64-compiler-rt-18
-            - wasm32-wasi-compiler-rt-18
-            - win32-compiler-rt-18
-            - win64-aarch64-compiler-rt-18
-            - win64-compiler-rt-18

+            - win64-compiler-rt-19
